full_text:
Running (skill)

Description: Speed and stamina drain when running.

Introduction. Running is a skill.

Effects. Improves sprinting speed by up to +25% and reduces stamina drain down to -50%.

Leveling up. The player gains 0.2 Experience per second while sprinting. Sprinting even a fraction of a second will still accumulate xp proportionally. Slope, weight carried, and movement modifiers do not affect the xp gain.

Speed. Characters sprint at 24km/h with 0 skill level and at 30km/h with 100 levels. Speed can be further increased by various means:
• An active Nimble Anklet trinket: +15%
• Consuming a Tonic of Ratatosk: +15%
• Wearing any Fenris Set pieces: +3% each, (+9% total)
• Active Moder Power: +10%
• Wearing Asksvin cloak: up to +25%.
Characters walk at 13.5km/h no matter the run skill level.
